## Summary

Adds response-window hidden-state capture for rollout training (#56916). Callers select a response range `[start, end)` and receive only those hidden-state rows, with optional aligned raw top-k logprobs.

The window is collected during generation through the AuxOutput Connector, reducing GPU-to-CPU transfers compared with full-response capture. It supports final hidden states and configured speculative auxiliary outputs.

## Implementation

- Python API: `SamplingParams.extra_args["hidden_state_capture"]`; the engine resolves response offsets after tokenization.
- Copies selected rows to pinned CPU memory and delivers them through the existing output-completion event.
- Tracks accepted tokens across speculative rejection and KV preemption; supports DELTA and FINAL_ONLY delivery.
- Validates requests at admission, enforces `max_logprobs` and a configurable capture-memory budget, and reports unavailable capture data per request.

API examples and supported configurations: [documentation](https://github.com/vx120/vllm/blob/windowed-hidden-state-collection/docs/features/speculative_decoding/windowed_hidden_states.md). This PR exposes the Python API.

## Performance

Measured on RTX 5090 32GB GPUs: Qwen3-4B + DSpark block-7, BF16, MRV2, CUDA Graphs, 7 speculative tokens; 512 input/output tokens, batch 4, 8 requests, window `[128,160)`. Results are the median of two paired rounds after warmup, using synthetic repeated-text prompts.

| Configuration | Throughput gain vs full capture¹ | Generation-time overhead vs capture off |
|---|---:|---:|
| TP1 | **6.61%** | **0.10%** |
| TP2 | **15.04%** | **0.32%** |

**D2H volume drops from approximately 15.1 MiB to 0.94 MiB per request (94% reduction).**

¹ Includes CPU delivery and export; both modes export the same 32 rows. Including export, Window/Off elapsed-time overhead is 0.55% on TP1 and 1.97% on TP2.

| Configuration | Capture off (tokens/s) | Full capture (tokens/s) | Window capture (tokens/s) | Window TTFT P95 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TP1 | 2939.17 | 2742.09 | **2923.23** | 115.35 ms |
| TP2 | 3346.09 | 2852.42 | **3281.39** | 106.34 ms |

Throughput includes export. Each entry is the median across measured rounds; the improvement percentages above use paired per-round ratios.

Additional measurements:

- **Unreached window:** zero hidden-state D2H; generation time stays within 0.2% of capture off on both TP1 and TP2.
- **Pinned memory:** approximately 39 KiB active after window settlement; allocator lifetime peaks of 2.23 MiB on TP1 and 2.13 MiB on the TP2 returning rank.
- **EAGLE3 TP1:** a separate one-round smoke benchmark passed correctness and showed 1.40% Window/Full throughput improvement with 0.18% generation-time overhead vs capture off (128 input/output tokens, batch 2, two requests, 32-row window).


## Validation

**14 CPU tests, 7 GPU tests, and all 18 applicable pre-commit hooks passed.**

- Eager and CUDA Graph execution, mixed batches, buffer reuse, KV preemption, and DELTA/FINAL_ONLY delivery.
- Exact Full/Window hidden-state equality; accepted-prefix prefill recomputation matches captured decode states exactly. LM-head recomputation verifies top-k values and token IDs.
- DSpark auxiliary capture on TP1/TP2 and EAGLE3 on TP1.
- Six scenarios passed with `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`.

> 
> ## 审计版本
> HEAD: [5f7938a](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/5f7938a33ef8705638df1cbed59d3c37132f99c1) BASE / merge-base: [bfa7e5b](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/bfa7e5b7afe40ebe48288801a2baf5c1135cd881) 24 个文件。开始与结束重新查询 GitHub，HEAD 未变化。 审计使用隔离 worktree，仅新增回归测试；未修改 PR 实现代码。
> 
> ## 第一性原理：审计所采用的必要契约
> R1. 对 L 个 prompt token，第 j 个生成 token 由 h[L-1+j] 预测。因此 response [a,b) 对应 absolute [L-1+a,L-1+b)。这里返回的是预测该 response token 的 hidden state，不是消耗该 token 后的下一位置状态。RFC #56916 明确规定这一语义。 R2. 一个实际 forward 的第 i 个请求占用 query_start_loc[i:i+2] 指定的行，其绝对起点为该 forward 开始前的 computed token 数。必须先对所有请求推进 row offset，再按各自窗口取交集；不能按采集请求重新紧密编号。 R3. speculative forward 可以产生未被接受的候选 row。GPU 先按窗口复制，scheduler 再按实际交付的 token 区间过滤；同一 mask 必须用于 positions 和 states。 R4. CPU payload 可读必须晚于 D2H 完成，且 graph output 在覆盖前必须完成读取。MRV2 当前在 main stream 排队复制，output-copy stream wait_stream(main_stream) 后记录 event，get_output 同步 event，建立传递的 happens-before。blocking=True/False 不改变这个就绪契约。 R5. 每个请求独立拥有 plan/buffer；窗口完成和请求终止需要清理 worker plan。输出结果不得因为 DELTA coalescing、内部 ID 改写或 FINAL_ONLY 延迟而丢失。 R6. 校验对象必须是实际执行的参数；不支持的组合应明确拒绝或返回说明，不能先校验另一份参数再执行不兼容请求。 R7. copied_bytes/copy_ms 是提交或执行过的复制开销，不应因 row 后来被过滤、重算或没有新 token 而消失。有效 row 数和复制开销是不同指标。 R8. capture 未开启时不应引入无关调度、模型输出或全局等待策略变化；性能优化需要对应 feature-off 和 CPU 开销证据。
> 
> 与 RFC 对照：响应坐标、半开窗口、稀疏 hidden_positions 为准、短样本/min_rows、request-local 状态等设计有合理依据。aux capture 只复用模型已有 speculative aux outputs，不能采任意未配置层；PCP/DCP、async scheduling、adaptive verification、encoder-decoder 均被拒绝。以上是支持范围，不是全组合通过证明。
> 
> ## F1 [P2] PP 抢占后交付 token，却丢失对应 hidden row
> 位置：vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:2214–2216。 触发：同步调度、PP=2，一个已排队 forward 在 KV 抢占后返回；output_is_stale=True，但 drop_stale_output=False。现有 scheduler 仍 append/交付这一步 token。 问题：新增条件 `and not output_is_stale` 无条件禁止该步 capture_buffer.update。worker 返回的有效 row 被抛弃；后续重算 row 又被新的 accepted interval 排除，最终返回 insufficient_rows。 复现：prompt 长度 2，window response [0,1)，采样先返回 [42]（对应 absolute row 1），随后 [43]。42 确实交付，row 1 也由模拟 worker 返回，但采集结果为 None，skip=insufficient_rows。 新增测试：test_audit_capture_keeps_hidden_row_for_delivered_stale_pp_token。 根因对照：仅在该测试进程中移除此 blanket stale guard，便收到 row 1，测试通过。结果可能在第一步产生，测试接受任一输出携带它；不是强求第二步重复 payload。 建议：基于该步是否实际交付 token 和 immutable row position 接受 capture，区分“必须丢弃的 stale output”和“仍交付的 stale output”。或在修复前明确拒绝这种 PP/抢占组合。这个对照不是对所有 speculative/PP stale 情况的生产修复证明。
> 
> ## F2 [P2] 两个引擎入口校验了错误的 SamplingParams 对象
> 位置：vllm/v1/engine/async_llm.py:519–520；vllm/v1/engine/llm_engine.py:296–297。 触发：仍被支持的 EngineCoreRequest 输入自带 sampling_params，外层 add_request 的 params 不是同一份。 问题：validate_hidden_state_capture(plan, request, params, config) 检查外层 params；之后才 params=request.params 并执行或 fan out。 复现：实际 request.params 分别设为 SamplingParams(n=2) 和 SamplingParams(stop="END")；外层传 SamplingParams()。两种本应拒绝的请求都通过准入，新增测试均报 DID NOT RAISE ValueError。 后果：n>1 进入不支持的 parent/child 输出和 plan ID 路径；stop string 绕过原本为防止 frontend 提前停止丢失捕获数据而设置的限制。 新增测试：test_audit_capture_checks_effective_engine_request_params 的两个参数化 case。运行时复现 AsyncLLM，LLMEngine 的同构代码已静态确认；没有将同步入口的静态结论伪称为另一次运行测试。 根因对照：validator 使用 request.params 后，两例均在 admission 前按预期拒绝。 建议：以 request.params 为唯一事实来源。可以让 validator 直接读 request.params，并删除独立 params 形参，既修复错配又减少 API 状态。
> 
> ## F3 [P2] 无新 token 的重算复制没有计入 D2H 统计
> 位置：vllm/v1/hidden_state_capture.py:309–310。 触发：窗口尚未完成，重算已有输出对应的 rows，但该 step 没有新 token 被接受，accepted_start==accepted_end。 问题：chunk 已经由 worker 复制到 CPU，update 却不调用 add，copied_bytes/copy_ms 都被忽略。这与 accepted() 保留过滤前复制元数据的设计相矛盾。 复现：三个合成 chunk 的元数据各表示已复制 16 bytes、copy_ms=1；第二个 chunk 仅是 replay，没有新 accepted token。最终 rows 正确为 [0,1,2,3]，但报告 copied_bytes=32 而实际提交元数据之和为 48。 新增测试：test_audit_capture_accounts_for_copy_during_replay_without_new_tokens。 根因对照：先累计每个返回 chunk 的复制元数据，再独立过滤/保存 accepted rows，测试通过。 边界：这是计数协议的 CPU 单元复现，48 bytes 不是实际 GPU profiling 测量。原普通无抢占 benchmark 不因此自动失效，但重算场景的传输量和收益统计会不准确。 建议：拆开“记复制开销”和“保存有效 row”，确保一个 chunk 计一次。对于完全丢弃的 stale/error 输出，物理 D2H 应另有覆盖完整生命周期的计量渠道。
> 
> ## F4 [P2] PR 自带 output-processor 回归测试与实现相冲突
> 位置：tests/v1/engine/test_output_processor.py:59、84–87。 相关实现：vllm/v1/engine/output_processor.py:425–434。 问题：SamplingParams(detokenize=False) 默认 output_kind=CUMULATIVE，且该步未 finished。实现只在 finished 或 DELTA 返回 skip_reason；测试却要求首个 token 的 CUMULATIVE output 立即含 aux_layers_unavailable。 本轮原测试实际失败：None != 'aux_layers_unavailable'。TTFT/prefill 统计的目标有必要，但断言使用的输出模式不匹配。 对照：只把这条测试的参数显式设为 DELTA，原统计与 skip 断言全部通过。 建议：明确测试 DELTA 即时投递；另用现有 suite 验证 CUMULATIVE/FINAL_ONLY 的最终投递与清理，而不是修改生产行为来迎合错误的测试模式。
> 
> ## C1 GPU CI 覆盖缺口
> 位置：.buildkite/test_areas/misc.yaml:222；tests/v1/test_hidden_state_capture.py:175–255。 PR 新增的 CI 命令位于 CPU job。三个 layout × 两种 event wait 的六个 CUDA Graph buffer-reuse case 在没有 CUDA 的 job 会跳过。本轮 CPU 测试也确实跳过六例。 建议：在 GPU job 显式接入这六例。作者手工运行旧提交的 GPU tests 与每次提交持续执行的 GPU CI 是两种证据，不能相互替代。
> 
> ## 可精简项
> N1. hidden_state_capture.py:266–270：HiddenStateCaptureBuffer.num_rows 无生产或测试调用；每次执行 unique(concat) 的 property 是死 API，可直接删除 5 行，不影响当前调用。 N2. hidden_state_capture.py:62–63、70–71：from_window 的窗口/prompt/min_rows 检查与 **post_init** 已有不变量重复。offset 的构造保持窗口长度和顺序；prompt_len-1+start 的下界也由 **post_init** 验证。可以统一由 dataclass 检查，减少 4 行，但错误文本会改变；coordinate 分支仍需保留。 N3. scheduler.py:2126：num_rejected=0 无读取。唯一读取位于 spec 分支，该分支已先执行 num_rejected=num_draft_tokens-num_accepted。该初始化可直接删除 1 行。 N4. gpu/async_utils.py:125–126、135–136 与 gpu/model_runner.py:2257–2261：blocking 参数和选择策略不决定 capture 数据是否完成，只决定 host 使用睡眠还是 spin 等待。当前策略在 capture Off 时也改变单卡 Graph 请求的既有行为。至少应独立提交/解释并验证 feature-off 与 CPU 开销；若只为此功能优化，可限定影响范围。这里发现的是必要性和回归证据缺口，不是已测得某个性能下降数值。 N5. F2 的 validator params 形参可以消除，让校验和执行共享 request.params。不要只用两处调用层补丁掩盖双参数源的设计风险。
> 
> ## 为何没有建议删除其余关键代码
> frozen plan 防止同批请求共享计划后被原地重写；replace 是重新绑定 request_id 所需，而不是冗余复制大 tensor。 finished_hidden_capture_req_ids 与 finished_req_ids 生命周期不同：窗口可以在 generation 结束前完成；不能简单合并成只有 finished_req_ids。 query_start_loc 的验证防止 prompt-logprob batch 实际行边界错配；不能用“采集请求每请求一行”的假设替代。 accepted positions/state 同 mask、去重和显式 sparse positions 支持 speculative rejection、短结果与 replay；不要用连续 arange 填补实际缺失 row。 pinned CPU buffer + non_blocking copy 与 output event 传递同步是 Graph buffer reuse 正确性的必要组合；不能只删除 event wait 来换吞吐。 RequestOutput.add 的非空合并保证异步 collector 比消费端更快时早期 DELTA capture 不丢；直接覆盖为 None 会破坏该契约。 HTTP schema 的 dtype/shape 和 Base64 原始 bytes 避免 BF16 经 NumPy 浮点转换而变值。MRV1 同步复制与 MRV2 异步复制的开销作用域不同，copy_ms 不能统一称为纯 GPU copy duration。 空行、括号、许可和注释已逐行列入 ledger；它们不承担独立运行时逻辑，不能把“每一行必要”解释为每个空行都有算法必要性。
> 
> ## 实测验证与环境
> 复用本机已有 .venv：Python 3.12.3、PyTorch 2.11.0+cu130；只运行 CPU 控制逻辑，CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES 为空。将已有同 PyTorch 环境原生库 symlink 到隔离 worktree，没有安装依赖或重编译。 这不是原 GB200 nightly PyTorch 2.13.0 环境，不能据此宣称最新 HEAD 的全部 CUDA/native/model 执行已验证。 最初缺少 worktree 的 flash-attn native artifact，collection 失败；复用已有库后解决。PP fixture 会因隐藏 GPU 后 device_count=0 无法构造配置，audit_runtime_plugin 仅为两条模拟 PP 测试提供 device_count=2；没有启动分布式进程、真实 GPU forward 或修改 scheduler 行为。
> 
> 最新 HEAD 原实现 + 新增审计回归：23 passed、5 failed、6 skipped。五个失败是 F1、F2 的两例、F3、F4；其中 F4 是 PR 原有测试，其余四例是本轮新增。 进程内根因对照：5 passed。每个对照只作用于对应测试；无生产修复已落入源码。对照证明失败来源，不能冒充 PR 原实现通过。 Ruff check/format 与 git diff --check 的结果另存。检查对象为原受影响代码及新增审计测试/工具，范围由命令和日志记录。
>

> CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-sync --python .venv/bin/python .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p audit_runtime_plugin tests/v1/test_hidden_state_capture.py tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py tests/v1/engine/test_admission_control.py tests/v1/engine/test_output_processor.py tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion_error.py -k 'hidden_capture or capture_skip or capture_positions or hidden_state_base64 or test_audit_capture' -q --disable-warnings
> 
> CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-sync --python .venv/bin/python .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p audit_runtime_plugin -p audit_positive_controls tests/v1/test_hidden_state_capture.py tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py tests/v1/engine/test_admission_control.py tests/v1/engine/test_output_processor.py -k 'test_audit_capture or capture_skip_with_first_token' -q --disable-warnings
> ```
> 
> ## 旧 GB200 结论的使用边界
> 旧提交 [5d4cf1e](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/5d4cf1e560f645068d8cb49a53c1d381fe58122e) 的 0.149414 最大误差已经由 top-k 排列顺序不稳定解释；固定顺序后该 workload 的 token/窗口数据逐位一致。这只排除了当时 workload 的 capture copy 错误，不能据此断言完整 PR 没有 PP、准入或统计问题。 当前 PR description 将原 DeepSeek 性能数字与未加限定的“Correctness checks passed”放在一起。应说明原 benchmark 质量门禁未通过、确定性排序对照才通过，并且排序后性能没有重新测量；不能将两组证据合并成同一配置的完整通过结果。
> 
> ## 合并前仍需完成
> 修复 F1–F3，修正 F4，接入 GPU CI，删除无用/重复代码并解释 feature-off wait-policy 变化。 在最新 HEAD 和对应 nightly/native 环境验证 MRV1/MRV2、真实 PP 抢占、speculative rejection、mixed batch、prefix cache、aux layouts 的位置对齐和输出生命周期。补充一个独立的 teacher-forcing/model-state reference；Full/Window 两路径相等本身不能排除共同的位置错配。 按修正后的同一配置重跑必要的 correctness/performance gate。未完成这些验证前，本审计不建议批准合并，不承诺“所有行绝对正确”。
> 
> ## 可复制的复现附件
> 以下仅为回归测试与诊断插件，不是生产修复。先应用测试 patch，再把两个插件保存到 checkout 根目录，运行上面的命令。
> 
> 新增回归测试 patch（F1/F2/F3，共四个 case）

[P2] Finalize capture when a stop string ends the request in the frontend

Capture is finalized in the scheduler only when its window completes or the scheduler observes the request stopping. A stop string is detected later in this output processor: it emits a finished response and aborts EngineCore. If generation stops inside the capture window, the scheduler's buffered rows are discarded without `finish()`, including a partial capture that satisfies `min_rows`. The finished response can therefore contain neither a capture nor a skip reason. A CPU output-processor probe confirms the stop-string path returns `finished=True`, both capture fields unset, and the request in `reqs_to_abort`.

Please coordinate capture finalization with frontend stop handling, or explicitly reject capture with stop strings until that combination is supported. Add a regression test that stops inside the window after meeting `min_rows`, and distinguish it from EOS/max-token termination.

+    }
+    last_tokens = 0
+    last_time = time.perf_counter()

+        prompt=prompt,
+        sampling_params=sampling_params,
+        request_id=request_id,
+        hidden_state_capture=plan,

The source changes address the four issues from my previous review: capture completion now uses accepted output progress; stop strings and streaming input are explicitly rejected at admission; and auxiliary-layer errors are retained until a normal output is emitted. RFC #56916 specifically asks for outside-window overhead measurements. ## Summary

Adds response-window hidden-state capture for rollout training (#56916). Callers select a response range `[start, end)` and receive only those hidden-state rows, with optional aligned raw top-k logprobs.

The window is collected during generation through the AuxOutput Connector, reducing GPU-to-CPU transfers compared with full-response capture. It supports final hidden states and configured speculative auxiliary outputs.

## Implementation

- Python API: `SamplingParams.extra_args["hidden_state_capture"]`; the engine resolves response offsets after tokenization.
- Copies selected rows to pinned CPU memory and delivers them through the existing output-completion event.
- Tracks accepted tokens across speculative rejection and KV preemption; supports DELTA and FINAL_ONLY delivery.
- Validates requests at admission, enforces `max_logprobs` and a configurable capture-memory budget, and reports unavailable capture data per request.

API examples and supported configurations: [documentation](https://github.com/vx120/vllm/blob/windowed-hidden-state-collection/docs/features/speculative_decoding/windowed_hidden_states.md). This PR exposes the Python API.

## Performance

Measured on RTX 5090 32GB GPUs: Qwen3-4B + DSpark block-7, BF16, MRV2, CUDA Graphs, 7 speculative tokens; 512 input/output tokens, batch 4, 8 requests, window `[128,160)`. Results are the median of two paired rounds after warmup, using synthetic repeated-text prompts.

| Configuration | Throughput gain vs full capture¹ | Generation-time overhead vs capture off |
|---|---:|---:|
| TP1 | **6.61%** | **0.10%** |
| TP2 | **15.04%** | **0.32%** |

**D2H volume drops from approximately 15.1 MiB to 0.94 MiB per request (94% reduction).**

¹ Includes CPU delivery and export; both modes export the same 32 rows. Including export, Window/Off elapsed-time overhead is 0.55% on TP1 and 1.97% on TP2.

| Configuration | Capture off (tokens/s) | Full capture (tokens/s) | Window capture (tokens/s) | Window TTFT P95 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TP1 | 2939.17 | 2742.09 | **2923.23** | 115.35 ms |
| TP2 | 3346.09 | 2852.42 | **3281.39** | 106.34 ms |

Throughput includes export. Each entry is the median across measured rounds; the improvement percentages above use paired per-round ratios.

Additional measurements:

- **Unreached window:** zero hidden-state D2H; generation time stays within 0.2% of capture off on both TP1 and TP2.
- **Pinned memory:** approximately 39 KiB active after window settlement; allocator lifetime peaks of 2.23 MiB on TP1 and 2.13 MiB on the TP2 returning rank.
- **EAGLE3 TP1:** a separate one-round smoke benchmark passed correctness and showed 1.40% Window/Full throughput improvement with 0.18% generation-time overhead vs capture off (128 input/output tokens, batch 2, two requests, 32-row window).


## Validation

**14 CPU tests, 7 GPU tests, and all 18 applicable pre-commit hooks passed.**

- Eager and CUDA Graph execution, mixed batches, buffer reuse, KV preemption, and DELTA/FINAL_ONLY delivery.
- Exact Full/Window hidden-state equality; accepted-prefix prefill recomputation matches captured decode states exactly. LM-head recomputation verifies top-k values and token IDs.
- DSpark auxiliary capture on TP1/TP2 and EAGLE3 on TP1.
- Six scenarios passed with `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`.

@@ -0,0 +1,223 @@
+# Windowed hidden-state capture
+
+The AuxOutput Connector can return hidden rows for a request-local position range.
+It captures selected rows while the request runs and skips capture copies outside
+the range. It does not allocate a full-response GPU hidden-state cache.
+
+Two workloads use the same primitive:
+
+- **Drafter training data**: capture a window of generated tokens (for example,
+  response tokens 1000 to 2000) during rollout, optionally with the auxiliary
+  layers used by EAGLE3, DSpark or DFlash.
+- **Full-vocabulary on-policy distillation**: a teacher server scores a student
+  trajectory in one prefill and returns the final hidden rows of the trajectory.
+  The trainer rebuilds the teacher's full-vocabulary logits with the teacher's
+  output head instead of transferring dense logits.
+
+```python
+import os
+
+os.environ["VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER"] = "1"
+
+from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
+
+llm = LLM(
+    model="Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B",
+    async_scheduling=False,
+    max_num_seqs=8,
+    aux_output_config={"enable_hidden_states": True},
+)
+prompt_ids = llm.get_tokenizer().encode("Explain how GPUs work.")
+params = SamplingParams(
+    max_tokens=2048,
+    extra_args={"hidden_state_capture": {
+        "start": 1000,
+        "end": 2000,
+        "collection_id": "training-step-1",
+        "min_rows": 1000,
+    }},
+)
+output = llm.generate({"prompt_token_ids": prompt_ids}, params)[0]
+aux = output.aux_outputs
+if aux is not None and aux.hidden_state_capture is not None:
+    result = aux.hidden_state_capture
+    print(result.hidden_positions, result.hidden_states.shape)
+elif aux is not None:
+    print(aux.hidden_capture_skip_reason)
+```
+
+`RequestOutput.aux_outputs` is the single container for settled AuxOutput
+Connector results; it is `None` when nothing was settled for that output.
+
+Windows use zero-based, half-open response coordinates. `[1000, 2000)` contains
+1000 rows. The engine binds these offsets after tokenization, so text prompts do
+not require the caller to predict the token count. Legacy `asdict(plan)` inputs
+retain response offsets when their client prompt length differs from the engine.
+Absolute hidden position is `prompt_len - 1 + response_index`; row `p`
+predicts token `p + 1`. Results contain only rows associated with delivered tokens,
+including when speculative proposals are rejected or the request stops early.
+If generation ends before the window, the skip reason is `ended_before_window`.
+If fewer than `min_rows` are available, the reason is `insufficient_rows`.
+Prompt segments must contain every requested row, regardless of `min_rows`;
+missing prompt rows return `prompt_rows_unavailable`. Inconsistent tensor fields
+across chunks return `tensor_fields_mismatch`. Both failures are request-local.
+Auxiliary-layer capture requires a speculator that produces auxiliary hidden
+states; requests without one are rejected during input validation.
+
+`result.tensors` holds CPU tensors keyed by name: `hidden_states`, plus
+`logprobs` and `logprob_token_ids` when `logprob_topk` is set (also available as
+attributes). `hidden_positions`, layout, auxiliary layer IDs, `segments`,
+collection ID, copy bytes and `copy_ms` accompany the result.
+`copy_ms` measures CPU allocation and asynchronous-copy submission time,
+not completed GPU-to-CPU transfer time.
+The connector settles and releases its capture state when the window completes;
+the frontend retains the result until delivery. Cumulative/final-only output emits
+the result at completion, while delta output can deliver it when the window settles.
+
+Final-layer capture reuses normal model outputs. Auxiliary layouts reuse the
+layers already enabled for the configured speculative method: `aux_final` appends
+normalized final hidden states, and `dflash_aux` contains only auxiliary outputs.
+Requested layer IDs must match the runner's selected layers in order. The connector
+reports `aux_layers_unavailable` for an incompatible layout. Capturing does not
+disable auxiliary outputs needed by the speculative decoder itself.
+
+`logprob_topk` optionally includes window-aligned top-k raw logprobs and token IDs.
+These are computed before sampling penalties, temperature or grammar masks.
+The requested top-k must not exceed `max_logprobs` (unless it is -1) or the model
+vocabulary. Window length must not exceed `max_model_len`. Admission bounds
+retained payload bytes multiplied by `max_num_seqs` using
+`aux_output_config.max_hidden_capture_bytes` (256 MiB by default). This budget
+includes hidden values and top-k values/IDs; model logits and allocator caches
+are separate. Increase it explicitly for wider layouts or longer windows.
+Unavailable logit rows produce a request-local skip reason rather than a CUDA
+device assertion.
+After preemption, recomputed positions already delivered to the caller are excluded
+before hidden rows and logits are selected. Rejected speculative positions remain
+eligible for capture when they are computed again.
+
+## Prompt rows for teacher scoring
+
+Set `"coordinate": "absolute"` to address rows from the start of the prompt.
+Rows before `prompt_len - 1` form the `prompt` segment; later rows form the
+`output` segment, and a range crossing the boundary returns both (see
+`result.segments`). To score a student trajectory `x + y` with a teacher:
+
+```python
+scoring = SamplingParams(
+    max_tokens=1,
+    extra_args={"hidden_state_capture": {
+        "coordinate": "absolute",

+"""Request-local, position-based capture of model output hidden states.
+
+A capture plan names one absolute row range ``[start, end)``; row ``p`` is the
+hidden state that predicts token ``p + 1``. Rows before ``prompt_len - 1`` form
+the ``prompt`` segment (teacher scoring) and settle as soon as they are
+computed. Later rows form the ``output`` segment (generation windows) and
+settle with accepted tokens. Rows outside the range are never copied.
+"""

+    """Capture chunks disagree on their tensor fields."""

+    kind: Literal["prompt", "output"]
+    start_abs: int
+    end_abs: int

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class HiddenStateCapturePlan:
+    request_id: str
+    prompt_len: int
+    window_start_abs: int
+    window_end_abs: int
+    collection_id: str
+    min_rows: int = 1
+    aux_layer_ids: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    hidden_layout: str = "final"
+    logprob_topk: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in (
+            "prompt_len",
+            "window_start_abs",
+            "window_end_abs",
+            "min_rows",
+            "logprob_topk",
+        ):

+            or self.window_start_abs < 0
+            or self.window_start_abs >= self.window_end_abs
+            or self.min_rows < 1
+            or self.min_rows > self.window_end_abs - self.window_start_abs
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid hidden-state capture plan")
+        if self.hidden_layout not in ("final", "aux_final", "dflash_aux"):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid hidden-state layout")
+        if bool(self.aux_layer_ids) != (self.hidden_layout != "final"):
+            raise ValueError("Hidden-state layout does not match auxiliary layers")
+        if len(set(self.aux_layer_ids)) != len(self.aux_layer_ids):
+            raise ValueError("Duplicate auxiliary hidden-state layers")
+        if self.logprob_topk < 0:

+        prompt_len: int,
+        start: int,
+        end: int,
+        collection_id: str,
+        *,
+        coordinate: Literal["response", "absolute"] = "response",
+        min_rows: int = 1,
+        aux_layer_ids: tuple[int, ...] = (),
+        hidden_layout: str | None = None,
+        logprob_topk: int = 0,
+    ) -> HiddenStateCapturePlan:
+        if coordinate == "response":
+            offset = prompt_len - 1
+        elif coordinate == "absolute":
+            offset = 0
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unknown hidden-state coordinate: {coordinate}")
+        return cls(
+            request_id=request_id,
+            prompt_len=prompt_len,
+            window_start_abs=start + offset,
+            window_end_abs=end + offset,
+            collection_id=collection_id,
+            min_rows=min_rows,
+            aux_layer_ids=aux_layer_ids,
+            hidden_layout=hidden_layout or ("aux_final" if aux_layer_ids else "final"),
+            logprob_topk=logprob_topk,
+        )
+

+@dataclass
+class HiddenStateCaptureChunk:
+    positions: np.ndarray
+    tensors: dict[str, torch.Tensor]
+    copied_bytes: int = 0
+    copy_ms: float = 0.0
+    logits_contract: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def hidden_states(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.tensors[HIDDEN_STATES]
+
+    @property
+    def logprobs(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.tensors.get(LOGPROBS)
+
+    @property
+    def logprob_token_ids(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.tensors.get(LOGPROB_TOKEN_IDS)
+
+    def accepted(self, end: int) -> HiddenStateCaptureChunk:
+        """Keep rows whose predicted token has been delivered."""
+        keep = self.positions < end
+        if keep.all():
+            return self
+        index = torch.from_numpy(keep)
+        return replace(
+            self,
+            positions=self.positions[keep],
+            tensors={name: value[index] for name, value in self.tensors.items()},
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def concat(cls, chunks: list[HiddenStateCaptureChunk]) -> HiddenStateCaptureChunk:
+        if len(chunks) == 1:
+            return chunks[0]
+        names = set(chunks[0].tensors)
+        if any(set(chunk.tensors) != names for chunk in chunks[1:]):
+            raise InconsistentTensorFieldsError("tensor_fields_mismatch")
+        return cls(
+            positions=np.concatenate([chunk.positions for chunk in chunks]),
+            tensors={
+                name: torch.cat([chunk.tensors[name] for chunk in chunks])
+                for name in names
+            },
+            copied_bytes=sum(chunk.copied_bytes for chunk in chunks),
+            copy_ms=sum(chunk.copy_ms for chunk in chunks),
+            logits_contract=chunks[-1].logits_contract,
+        )
+

+def drop_incompatible_aux_plans(
+    plans: dict[str, HiddenStateCapturePlan],
+    req_ids: list[str],
+    available_layer_ids: tuple[int, ...],
+    aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] | None,
+) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Disable captures whose requested auxiliary layout cannot be produced."""
+    errors: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for req_id in req_ids:
+        plan = plans.get(req_id)
+        if plan is None or not plan.aux_layer_ids:
+            continue
+        if (
+            aux_hidden_states is None
+            or plan.aux_layer_ids != available_layer_ids
+            or len(aux_hidden_states) != len(available_layer_ids)
+        ):
+            plans.pop(req_id)
+            errors[req_id] = "aux_layers_unavailable"
+    return errors

+def capture_scheduled_hidden_states(
+    plans: dict[str, HiddenStateCapturePlan],
+    req_ids: list[str],
+    num_scheduled_tokens: dict[str, int],
+    num_computed_tokens: dict[str, int],
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+    query_start_loc: np.ndarray | None = None,
+    *,
+    logits: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    cu_num_logits: np.ndarray | None = None,
+    settled_ends: dict[str, int] | None = None,
+    errors: dict[str, str] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, HiddenStateCaptureChunk]:
+    """Snapshot only window rows before reusable model buffers are overwritten.
+
+    Rows below ``settled_ends`` were already delivered and are skipped when a
+    preempted request recomputes its history.
+    """
+    chunks: dict[str, HiddenStateCaptureChunk] = {}
+    row_offset = 0
+    for index, req_id in enumerate(req_ids):
+        num_rows = num_scheduled_tokens[req_id]
+        if query_start_loc is not None:
+            row_offset = int(query_start_loc[index])
+            if int(query_start_loc[index + 1]) - row_offset != num_rows:
+                raise ValueError("Scheduled hidden-state row boundaries do not match")
+        plan = plans.get(req_id)
+        if plan is not None:
+            start = num_computed_tokens[req_id]
+            first = max(
+                start, plan.window_start_abs, (settled_ends or {}).get(req_id, 0)
+            )
+            end = min(start + num_rows, plan.window_end_abs)
+            if first < end:
+                first_row = row_offset + first - start
+                end_row = row_offset + end - start
+                if plan.aux_layer_ids:
+                    if aux_hidden_states is None or len(aux_hidden_states) != len(
+                        plan.aux_layer_ids
+                    ):
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            "Requested auxiliary hidden layers are unavailable"
+                        )
+                    parts = [state[first_row:end_row] for state in aux_hidden_states]
+                    if plan.includes_final_layer:
+                        parts.append(hidden_states[first_row:end_row])
+                    states = torch.cat(parts, dim=-1)
+                else:
+                    states = hidden_states[first_row:end_row]
+                # Graph outputs are reused by the next forward; own selected rows.
+                tensors = {HIDDEN_STATES: states.detach().clone()}
+                if plan.logprob_topk:
+                    if logits is None or cu_num_logits is None:
+                        if errors is not None:
+                            errors[req_id] = "logits_unavailable"
+                        row_offset += num_rows
+                        continue
+                    logit_start, logit_end = map(int, cu_num_logits[index : index + 2])
+                    # MRV2 places each request's logits on its query suffix.
+                    query_logit_start = (
+                        row_offset + num_rows - (logit_end - logit_start)
+                    )
+                    if first_row < query_logit_start or logit_end > logits.shape[0]:
+                        if errors is not None:
+                            errors[req_id] = "logits_rows_unavailable"
+                        row_offset += num_rows
+                        continue
+                    selected_start = logit_start + first_row - query_logit_start
+                    scores = logits[
+                        selected_start : selected_start + end_row - first_row
+                    ].float()
+                    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.logprob import compute_token_logprobs
+
+                    _, token_ids = scores.topk(plan.logprob_topk, dim=-1)
+                    tensors[LOGPROBS] = compute_token_logprobs(scores, token_ids)
+                    tensors[LOGPROB_TOKEN_IDS] = token_ids
+                chunks[req_id] = HiddenStateCaptureChunk(
+                    positions=np.arange(first, end, dtype=np.int64),
+                    tensors=tensors,
+                    copied_bytes=sum(
+                        t.numel() * t.element_size() for t in tensors.values()
+                    ),
+                )
+        row_offset += num_rows
+    return chunks
+

+@dataclass
+class HiddenStateCaptureResult:
+    hidden_positions: np.ndarray
+    tensors: dict[str, torch.Tensor]
+    hidden_position_start: int
+    hidden_position_end: int
+    hidden_window_start: int
+    hidden_window_end: int
+    hidden_layout: str
+    layer_ids: tuple[int, ...]
+    includes_final_layer: bool
+    collection_id: str
+    segments: tuple[CaptureSegment, ...] = ()
+    copied_bytes: int = 0
+    copy_ms: float = 0.0
+    # LogitsProcessor parameters for rebuilding logits from the final layer:
+    # logits = soft_cap(h @ W_head.T)[:, :vocab_size] * logit_scale.
+    logits_contract: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def hidden_states(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.tensors[HIDDEN_STATES]
+
+    @property
+    def logprobs(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.tensors.get(LOGPROBS)
+
+    @property
+    def logprob_token_ids(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.tensors.get(LOGPROB_TOKEN_IDS)

+@dataclass
+class HiddenStateCaptureBuffer:
+    plan: HiddenStateCapturePlan
+    chunks: list[HiddenStateCaptureChunk] = field(default_factory=list)
+    copied_bytes: int = 0
+    copy_ms: float = 0.0
+    error: str | None = None
+    settled_end: int = 0
+    logits_contract: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    def add(self, chunk: HiddenStateCaptureChunk) -> None:
+        self.copied_bytes += chunk.copied_bytes
+        self.copy_ms += chunk.copy_ms
+        if chunk.logits_contract is not None:
+            self.logits_contract = chunk.logits_contract
+        if chunk.positions.size:
+            self.chunks.append(chunk)
+            self.settled_end = max(self.settled_end, int(chunk.positions.max()) + 1)
+
+    def finish(self) -> HiddenStateCaptureResult | None:
+        plan = self.plan
+        prompt_end = min(plan.window_end_abs, plan.output_start)
+        if not self.chunks:
+            if plan.window_start_abs < prompt_end:
+                self.error = "prompt_rows_unavailable"
+            return None
+        positions = np.concatenate([chunk.positions for chunk in self.chunks])
+        unique_indices = None
+        if np.any(positions[1:] <= positions[:-1]):
+            positions, unique_indices = np.unique(positions, return_index=True)
+        if plan.window_start_abs < prompt_end and not np.array_equal(
+            positions[positions < prompt_end],
+            np.arange(plan.window_start_abs, prompt_end),
+        ):
+            self.error = "prompt_rows_unavailable"
+            return None
+        names = set(self.chunks[0].tensors)
+        if HIDDEN_STATES not in names or any(
+            set(chunk.tensors) != names for chunk in self.chunks[1:]
+        ):
+            self.error = "tensor_fields_mismatch"
+            return None
+        if self.plan.logprob_topk and not {LOGPROBS, LOGPROB_TOKEN_IDS} <= names:
+            self.error = "logprob_rows_unavailable"
+            return None
+        if len(positions) < self.plan.min_rows:
+            return None
+        tensors = (
+            self.chunks[0].tensors
+            if len(self.chunks) == 1
+            else {
+                name: torch.cat([chunk.tensors[name] for chunk in self.chunks])
+                for name in names
+            }
+        )
+        if unique_indices is not None:
+            index = torch.from_numpy(unique_indices)
+            tensors = {name: tensor[index] for name, tensor in tensors.items()}
+        return HiddenStateCaptureResult(
+            hidden_positions=positions,
+            tensors={name: tensors[name] for name in sorted(names)},
+            hidden_position_start=int(positions[0]),
+            hidden_position_end=int(positions[-1]) + 1,
+            hidden_window_start=plan.window_start_abs,
+            hidden_window_end=plan.window_end_abs,
+            hidden_layout=plan.hidden_layout,
+            layer_ids=plan.aux_layer_ids,
+            includes_final_layer=plan.includes_final_layer,
+            collection_id=plan.collection_id,
+            segments=plan.segments,
+            copied_bytes=self.copied_bytes,
+            copy_ms=self.copy_ms,
+            logits_contract=self.logits_contract if plan.includes_final_layer else None,
+        )
+
+    def update(
+        self,
+        chunk: HiddenStateCaptureChunk | None,
+        accepted_end: int,
+        *,
+        stopped: bool,
+        error: str | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[HiddenStateCaptureResult | None, str | None]:
+        """Settle returned rows; prompt rows are always below accepted_end."""
+        if error is not None:
+            self.error = error
+        if self.error is not None:
+            return None, self.error
+        if chunk is not None:
+            self.add(chunk.accepted(accepted_end))
+        if not stopped and accepted_end < self.plan.window_end_abs:
+            return None, None
+        result = self.finish()
+        if self.error is not None:
+            return None, self.error
+        if result is not None:
+            return result, None
+        reason = (
+            "ended_before_window"
+            if stopped and accepted_end <= self.plan.window_start_abs
+            else "insufficient_rows"
+        )
+        return None, reason
+
+
+CAPTURE_KEY = "hidden_state_capture"
+
+
+def capture_plan(
+    params: SamplingParams, request_id: str, prompt_len: int
+) -> HiddenStateCapturePlan | None:
+    spec = (params.extra_args or {}).get(CAPTURE_KEY)
+    if spec is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if not isinstance(spec, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("capture specification must be a mapping")
+        spec = dict(spec)
+        spec["aux_layer_ids"] = tuple(spec.get("aux_layer_ids", ()))
+        if "start" in spec or "end" in spec:
+            return HiddenStateCapturePlan.from_window(
+                request_id=request_id, prompt_len=prompt_len, **spec
+            )
+        # Legacy asdict(plan) callers supplied their own prompt length.
+        # Preserve response offsets when binding the actual engine prompt.
+        client_prompt_len = spec.pop("prompt_len")
+        spec.pop("request_id", None)
+        spec["window_start_abs"] += prompt_len - client_prompt_len
+        spec["window_end_abs"] += prompt_len - client_prompt_len
+        return HiddenStateCapturePlan(
+            request_id=request_id, prompt_len=prompt_len, **spec
+        )
+    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
+        raise VLLMValidationError(
+            f"Invalid hidden capture specification: {exc}"
+        ) from exc
+
+
+def prompt_capture_start(params: SamplingParams, prompt_len: int) -> int | None:
+    """First prompt row a capture needs, which must not be a prefix-cache hit."""
+    if CAPTURE_KEY not in (params.extra_args or {}):
+        return None
+    plan = capture_plan(params, "", prompt_len)
+    if plan is None or plan.window_start_abs >= plan.output_start:
+        return None
+    return plan.window_start_abs
+
+
+def validate_capture_request(
+    params: SamplingParams,
+    prompt_len: int,
+    config: VllmConfig,
+    resumable: bool = False,
+) -> None:
+    plan = capture_plan(params, "", prompt_len)
+    if plan is None:
+        return
+    if not config.aux_output_config.enable_hidden_states:
+        raise VLLMValidationError(
+            "Hidden capture requires aux_output_config.enable_hidden_states"
+        )
+    if params.n != 1 or params.stop or resumable:
+        raise VLLMValidationError(
+            "Hidden capture requires n=1, no stop strings or streaming input"
+        )
+    if plan.aux_layer_ids:
+        from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.eagle3_utils import (
+            requires_aux_hidden_states,
+        )
+
+        if config.speculative_config is None or not requires_aux_hidden_states(
+            config.speculative_config
+        ):
+            raise VLLMValidationError(
+                "Auxiliary hidden capture requires an auxiliary-layer speculator"
+            )
+    if plan.logprob_topk > config.model_config.get_vocab_size():
+        raise VLLMValidationError("logprob_topk exceeds the model vocabulary")
+    maximum = config.model_config.max_logprobs
+    if maximum != -1 and plan.logprob_topk > maximum:
+        raise VLLMValidationError("logprob_topk exceeds max_logprobs")
+    rows = plan.window_end_abs - plan.window_start_abs
+    if rows > config.model_config.max_model_len:
+        raise VLLMValidationError("Hidden capture window exceeds max_model_len")
+    hidden_width = config.model_config.get_hidden_size() * (
+        len(plan.aux_layer_ids) + plan.includes_final_layer
+    )
+    element_size = torch.empty((), dtype=config.model_config.dtype).element_size()
+    payload_bytes = rows * (hidden_width * element_size + plan.logprob_topk * 12)
+    if payload_bytes * config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs > (
+        config.aux_output_config.max_hidden_capture_bytes
+    ):
+        raise VLLMValidationError(
+            "Hidden capture exceeds max_hidden_capture_bytes budget"
+        )

+class HiddenCaptureCarry:
+    """Hold copied rows until a step emits output for their request.
+
+    The scheduler settles auxiliary outputs only on steps that emit tokens, so
+    rows from intermediate prefill chunks wait here for the sampling chunk.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._chunks: dict[str, list[HiddenStateCaptureChunk]] = {}
+        self._errors: dict[str, str] = {}
+        self._lock = Lock()
+
+    def empty(self) -> bool:
+        return not self._chunks and not self._errors
+
+    def release(
+        self,
+        chunks: dict[str, HiddenStateCaptureChunk],
+        errors: dict[str, str],
+        emitted: Iterable[str],
+        logits_contract: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    ) -> dict[str, tuple[HiddenStateCaptureChunk | None, str | None]]:
+        with self._lock:
+            for request_id, chunk in chunks.items():
+                self._chunks.setdefault(request_id, []).append(chunk)
+            for request_id, error in errors.items():
+                self._errors.setdefault(request_id, error)
+            released: dict[str, tuple[HiddenStateCaptureChunk | None, str | None]] = {}
+            for request_id in emitted:
+                parts = self._chunks.pop(request_id, None)
+                release_error = self._errors.pop(request_id, None)
+                if parts is None and release_error is None:
+                    continue
+                released_chunk = None
+                if parts is not None:
+                    try:
+                        released_chunk = HiddenStateCaptureChunk.concat(parts)
+                    except InconsistentTensorFieldsError:
+                        release_error = release_error or "tensor_fields_mismatch"
+                    else:
+                        released_chunk.logits_contract = logits_contract
+                released[request_id] = (released_chunk, release_error)
+            return released
+
+    def discard(self, request_ids: Iterable[str]) -> None:
+        with self._lock:
+            for request_id in request_ids:
+                self._chunks.pop(request_id, None)
+                self._errors.pop(request_id, None)
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._chunks.clear()
+            self._errors.clear()
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PendingHiddenOutput:
+    owner: HiddenStateWorker
+    req_ids: list[str]
+    chunks: dict[str, HiddenStateCaptureChunk]
+    errors: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    gpu_tensors: list[torch.Tensor] = field(default_factory=list)
+    num_sampled: np.ndarray | None = None
+
+    def enqueue_cpu_copy(self, num_sampled: np.ndarray) -> None:
+        self.num_sampled = num_sampled
+        for chunk in self.chunks.values():
+            started = perf_counter()
+            for name, tensor in chunk.tensors.items():
+                self.gpu_tensors.append(tensor)
+                cpu = torch.empty_like(tensor, device="cpu", pin_memory=True)
+                cpu.copy_(tensor, non_blocking=True)
+                chunk.tensors[name] = cpu
+            chunk.copy_ms = (perf_counter() - started) * 1000
+
+    def process_output(
+        self,
+    ) -> dict[str, tuple[HiddenStateCaptureChunk | None, str | None]]:
+        assert self.num_sampled is not None, "hidden capture copy was not enqueued"
+        emitted = [
+            request_id
+            for request_id, num_sampled in zip(
+                self.req_ids, self.num_sampled, strict=True
+            )
+            if num_sampled > 0
+        ]
+        return self.owner.carry.release(
+            self.chunks, self.errors, emitted, self.owner.logits_contract
+        )
+

+def _supports_logits_reconstruction(
+    model_type: type[torch.nn.Module],
+    processor_type: type,
+    compute_logits: Callable[..., Any] | None,
+    *,
+    quantization: str | None,
+    lora_enabled: bool,
+    model_state_cls: type[ModelState],
+) -> bool:
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.qwen3 import Qwen3ForCausalLM
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.interface import ModelState
+
+    return (
+        model_type is Qwen3ForCausalLM
+        and processor_type is LogitsProcessor
+        and compute_logits is Qwen3ForCausalLM.compute_logits
+        and quantization is None
+        and not lora_enabled
+        and model_state_cls.compute_sample_logits is ModelState.compute_sample_logits
+    )

+def _public_capture_model_name(name: str | list[str] | None) -> str | None:
+    if isinstance(name, list):
+        name = name[0] if name else None
+    if name and (
+        Path(name).is_absolute()
+        or PureWindowsPath(name).is_absolute()
+        or name.startswith(".")

+def _logits_contract(
+    model: torch.nn.Module, config: VllmConfig
+) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.qwen3 import Qwen3ForCausalLM
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states import resolve_model_state_cls
+
+    if type(model) is not Qwen3ForCausalLM:
+        return None
+    processor = getattr(model, "logits_processor", None)
+    if not _supports_logits_reconstruction(
+        type(model),
+        type(processor),
+        getattr(model.compute_logits, "__func__", None),
+        quantization=config.model_config.quantization,
+        lora_enabled=config.lora_config is not None,
+        model_state_cls=resolve_model_state_cls(config, model),
+    ):
+        return None
+    assert processor is not None
+    hf_config = config.model_config.hf_text_config
+    tied = bool(getattr(hf_config, "tie_word_embeddings", False))
+    return {
+        "served_model_name": _public_capture_model_name(
+            config.model_config.served_model_name
+        ),
+        "revision": config.model_config.revision,
+        "lm_head_weight": "model.embed_tokens.weight" if tied else "lm_head.weight",
+        "vocab_size": int(processor.org_vocab_size),
+        "logit_scale": float(processor.scale),
+        "soft_cap": None if processor.soft_cap is None else float(processor.soft_cap),
+        "tie_word_embeddings": tied,
+    }

+class HiddenStateWorker:
+    def __init__(self, model: torch.nn.Module, config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+        from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.eagle3_utils import (
+            get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config,
+            requires_aux_hidden_states,
+        )
+
+        self.plans: dict[str, HiddenStateCapturePlan] = {}
+        self.settled_ends: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self.pending: PendingHiddenOutput | None = None
+        self.carry = HiddenCaptureCarry()
+        self.logits_contract = _logits_contract(model, config)
+        layers: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+        if config.speculative_config is not None and requires_aux_hidden_states(
+            config.speculative_config
+        ):
+            layers = (
+                get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config(config.speculative_config)
+                or model.get_eagle3_default_aux_hidden_state_layers()
+            )
+        self.layer_ids: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(sorted(set(layers)))
+
+    def begin_step(self, metadata: AuxOutputConnectorMetadata) -> None:
+        finished = metadata.finished_requests + metadata.finished_hidden_requests
+        for request_id in finished:
+            self.plans.pop(request_id, None)
+            self.settled_ends.pop(request_id, None)
+        self.carry.discard(finished)
+        self.plans.update(metadata.hidden_plans)
+        self.settled_ends.update(metadata.hidden_settled_ends)
+
+    def prepare(

[P2] Finalize capture when a stop string ends the request in the frontend

Capture is finalized in the scheduler only when its window completes or the scheduler observes the request stopping. A stop string is detected later in this output processor: it emits a finished response and aborts EngineCore. If generation stops inside the capture window, the scheduler's buffered rows are discarded without `finish()`, including a partial capture that satisfies `min_rows`. The finished response can therefore contain neither a capture nor a skip reason. A CPU output-processor probe confirms the stop-string path returns `finished=True`, both capture fields unset, and the request in `reqs_to_abort`.

Please coordinate capture finalization with frontend stop handling, or explicitly reject capture with stop strings until that combination is supported. Add a regression test that stops inside the window after meeting `min_rows`, and distinguish it from EOS/max-token termination.

> ## 第一性原理：审计所采用的必要契约
> R1. 对 L 个 prompt token，第 j 个生成 token 由 h[L-1+j] 预测。因此 response [a,b) 对应 absolute [L-1+a,L-1+b)。这里返回的是预测该 response token 的 hidden state，不是消耗该 token 后的下一位置状态。RFC #56916 明确规定这一语义。 R2. 一个实际 forward 的第 i 个请求占用 query_start_loc[i:i+2] 指定的行，其绝对起点为该 forward 开始前的 computed token 数。必须先对所有请求推进 row offset，再按各自窗口取交集；不能按采集请求重新紧密编号。 R3. speculative forward 可以产生未被接受的候选 row。GPU 先按窗口复制，scheduler 再按实际交付的 token 区间过滤；同一 mask 必须用于 positions 和 states。 R4. CPU payload 可读必须晚于 D2H 完成，且 graph output 在覆盖前必须完成读取。MRV2 当前在 main stream 排队复制，output-copy stream wait_stream(main_stream) 后记录 event，get_output 同步 event，建立传递的 happens-before。blocking=True/False 不改变这个就绪契约。 R5. 每个请求独立拥有 plan/buffer；窗口完成和请求终止需要清理 worker plan。输出结果不得因为 DELTA coalescing、内部 ID 改写或 FINAL_ONLY 延迟而丢失。 R6. 校验对象必须是实际执行的参数；不支持的组合应明确拒绝或返回说明，不能先校验另一份参数再执行不兼容请求。 R7. copied_bytes/copy_ms 是提交或执行过的复制开销，不应因 row 后来被过滤、重算或没有新 token 而消失。有效 row 数和复制开销是不同指标。 R8. capture 未开启时不应引入无关调度、模型输出或全局等待策略变化；性能优化需要对应 feature-off 和 CPU 开销证据。
> 
> 与 RFC 对照：响应坐标、半开窗口、稀疏 hidden_positions 为准、短样本/min_rows、request-local 状态等设计有合理依据。aux capture 只复用模型已有 speculative aux outputs，不能采任意未配置层；PCP/DCP、async scheduling、adaptive verification、encoder-decoder 均被拒绝。以上是支持范围，不是全组合通过证明。

The following suggestions were adopted:
- F1: Preserve hidden rows for stale PP tokens that are actually delivered, while retaining the existing drop behavior. This prevents missing capture rows after token delivery.
- F2 / N5: Validate EngineCoreRequest.params directly and remove the redundant parameter source, preventing effective n > 1 or stop-string settings from bypassing admission checks.
- F3: Account for copied bytes and time from returned chunks even when no new token is accepted. Filter stored rows separately by the accepted interval, so replay copies are counted.
- F4: Correct the tests for metadata delivery in DELTA, CUMULATIVE, and FINAL_ONLY modes, retaining the TTFT/prefill assertions and existing production output semantics.
- C1 / N1–N3: Wire capture tests into GPU CI and remove the unused num_rows property, duplicate invariant checks, and redundant initialization.
- N4: Restore upstream blocking=True and remove the wait-policy branch and extra parameter. Capture-disabled execution therefore retains the upstream wait policy. Graph output-reuse tests still cover all three hidden-state layouts.
Validation was performed using RTX 2080 Ti GPUs with Qwen3.5-0.8B FP16.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Reviewed head `666bb57c72` with three reviewers (the current Codex model, Claude Opus 5.5, and Kimi K3), followed by cross-checking and CPU probes. The inline comments distinguish four correctness issues from test improvements and optional simplifications; I recommend addressing the correctness issues before merging.

Validation: 13 capture helper tests and 8 standalone preflight helper tests passed; completion and serialization suites reported 55 passing tests combined. The broader scheduler run had 201 passes and two GPU-environment-related failures; some output-processor tests were blocked by a gated model configuration returning HTTP 403. No real GPU hidden-state numerical, pipeline-parallel, or performance validation was completed. The pipeline issue was reproduced by driving the real scheduler with two scheduled prefill chunks before consuming their outputs, rather than by running a GPU PP deployment.

Contract clarification: the linked RFC #56916 allows partial windows and treats `hidden_positions` as authoritative. Partial results meeting `min_rows` are therefore not inherently a bug; please align the PR description's claim about avoiding partial captures with the intended API contract.

Threading request-local metadata through the API, engine, scheduler, and workers is justified. The simplification suggestions focus on duplicated state and capture-specific bookkeeping rather than removing necessary propagation.

Follow-up review of `6f9e63baaf`.

The source changes address the four issues from my previous review: capture completion now uses accepted output progress; stop strings and streaming input are explicitly rejected at admission; and auxiliary-layer errors are retained until a normal output is emitted. The scheduler regressions, CPU CI wiring, removal of the unused state enum, and extraction of buffer finalization are also improvements. This is source-level verification, not a claim that I reran the updated tests.

I would still like the following evidence and design alignment before approval:

1. **Validate actual model hidden-state values and token alignment.** The synthetic scheduler tests check bookkeeping, but cannot establish that either GPU runner selects the correct model rows and auxiliary layers. The standalone GPU script was removed without a replacement real-model numerical comparison. Please provide a small reference comparison and feature-off/mixed-batch coverage, including speculative rejection and pipeline parallelism where support is claimed. If that matrix cannot be validated yet, narrow the initially supported combinations.

2. **Quantify serving overhead.** `capture_scheduled_hidden_states` still performs a blocking `states.detach().to("cpu")` per capturing request per step. Please report comparable throughput, TTFT and ITL for the baseline, capture unused, and the periods before/during/after the window. RFC #56916 specifically asks for outside-window overhead measurements. The current `11 passed, 3 deselected` helper result does not establish numerical correctness or acceptable serving overhead; please identify the deselected tests and explain why they were excluded. I am not asserting a measured slowdown without benchmark data.

3. **Clarify the public API and related work.** #57663 implements part of the same RFC, and the RFC discussion already records coordination; #59543 provides a related per-request hidden-state output with a different scope. Please update the duplicate-work section with those relationships and explain which API/implementation pieces should be shared or remain separate. These are not interchangeable implementations, so this is an alignment request rather than a recommendation to close this PR as a duplicate. Engine/runner and completion API owners should review that contract. Please also restore the AI-assistance disclosure that was present in the previous description.

Optional cleanup: `HiddenStateCaptureBuffer.num_rows` appears to have no remaining callers after finalization was moved into `update()`. It can be removed if it is not intended as a supported API. Further simplification would be most useful through a smaller initial auxiliary-layer/execution-mode scope, rather than additional generic abstractions.

This pass followed the evidence-gathering gate in the requested review-pr workflow. DCO and pre-commit were passing at inspection, but the available checks did not establish GPU runtime validation. No tests, builds, benchmarks, or model evaluations were run in this follow-up; the earlier runtime results should not be treated as validation of this new head.
